name: Szentlőrinckáta (Hungary)
description: White field with a narrow blue horizontal stripe near the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szentlőrinckáta: a crowned red, white and blue shield with bars and a figure, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed SZENTLŐRINCKÁTA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szentlőrinckáta arms with crown, wreath and scroll
